description:
Change part of an HTML or Markdown board without resending all of it.
Ops (applied in order, all or nothing):
- {"op": "write", "text": "..."} (replace everything)
- {"op": "append", "text": "..."}
- {"op": "replace", "find": "...", "replace": "..."} (find must occur exactly once)

board.description: The board's 22-character code, or its URL

name: edit_text
title: Edit an HTML or Markdown board
